get.summary: Get events through several different query parameters

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The from date to query; Events starting before but ending after this date are included. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The to date to query; Events starting before but ending after this date are included. yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

parameters.name: resource-id
parameters.description: Cannot be combined with locationId! Only events assigned to at least one of the passed resources will be returned. Multiple ids are queried like "resourceId=1234&resourceId=5678&resourceId=9012"

parameters.name: location-id
parameters.description: Cannot be combined with resourceId! Only events matching one of the passed locations will be returned. Multiple ids are queried like "locationId=1234&locationId=5678&locationId=9012"

parameters.name: resource-type-id
parameters.description: Can only be used with queryUnscheduled! The resource-types to query unscheduled events with

parameters.name: event-type
parameters.description: The type of event to filter for. Multiple types are queried like "eventType=STANDALONE&eventType=SERIES&eventType=TEST_STEP"

parameters.name: event-id
parameters.description: One or multiple ids of events to base the query on. Cannot be combined with any parameters other than fetch strategy

parameters.name: fetch-strategy
parameters.description: The strategy used for fetching events after they have been initially filtered. By default only returns the events themselves, but can also get only the root parent of each event or the entire event family (parents, children, sibling, etc.).

parameters.name: unscheduled
parameters.description: Only query those events whose status is ORD and which have no resources

parameters.name: location-fetch-strategy
parameters.description: The query strategy for locations. DEFAULT: Only query the specified locations; DESCDENDANTS: Query the specified locations and any descendants; Can only be used in combination with list of location ids!

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Cannot be combined with resource-id! The statuses to filter by

400.description: Malformed request; Further information in response body

put.summary: Save one or more existing events

200.description: Persisted; Returns all events as they are in DB

200.description: Events persisted; Returns all created events including their ids
